The team reopens the murder case of a young politician who promised to get rid of drug dealers preying on kids in the neighborhood he grew up in.

After an FDIC security guard is killed while tending to a pregnant woman in distress, the team works to locate the woman and the killer who took her hostage; OA and Isobel worry about Maggie as she navigates taking care of Ella.

title: FBI

The team is thrown into a highly political case after four members of the Taliban are shot and one is kidnapped in New York with no record of their entrance into the country; OA struggles to open up to Gemma about his past in Afghanistan.

title: FBI

When a truck driver is murdered and the drug he was transporting goes missing, the team hunts for those behind the remaining batch that is already wreaking havoc on the streets of New York.

The assassination of a seemingly ordinary Brooklyn plumber launches the team into a globe-spanning investigation that ruffles feathers with the CIA; Tiffany struggles with fieldwork in the aftermath of the Hakim case.

title: FBI
description:

The team is on the case when a suburban couple is murdered; all forensic evidence points to the home's previous owner, who is currently serving 10 years in federal prison; OA reunites with an old military colleague; Scola welcomes a new partner.

title: FBI

After a series of targeted bombings in Queens, the team fears a citywide gang war is imminent, until a tip from OA's old Army buddy, Clay, directs their attention to an unexpected and powerful foe; Scola continues to struggle to find a new partner.

title: FBI

When the sister of FBI Behavioral Analysis Unit profiler Sydney Ortiz is the victim of an attempted kidnapping and sexual assault, Sydney seeks help from Isobel and the team in tracking down a meticulous serial offender who leaves no evidence behind.

OA is forced to confront one of his biggest fears when the team discovers that deadly sarin gas may have been sold to terrorists.

title: FBI

When a morning show host is murdered inside her home, the team tracks the killer; things become awkward for Scola when agent Nina Chase becomes part of the team during Maggie's recovery.

title: FBI
description:

A killer is using drug mules to exploit airport security checkpoints; OA struggles to cope with the aftermath of the sarin gas exposure and the 10th anniversary of his army friend's death in Afghanistan.

title: FBI
description:

When a retired Drug Enforcement Administration agent is shot outside a bakery, the team works to determine if the victim's past cases or current bouncer job are connected to the murder; Nina and Tiffany clash over the use of an informant.

title: FBI
description:

Chaos erupts in the city when an attack disrupts cell, internet and emergency services; as the team races to uncover the culprits, they learn the group responsible is a radical accelerationist movement fixated on resetting society.

title: FBI
description:

When an undercover operation being led by Special Agent Nina Chase goes sideways, the team works together to flip their only witness to help them hunt down a rip crew at a cartel wedding; Nina and Scola realize they are ready to tie the knot.

title: FBI
description:

When a federal whistleblower is murdered while in FBI custody along with two agents, the team is stunned to find a familiar perpetrator has resurfaced; OA wrestles with telling the team what is happening in his personal life.

title: FBI
description:

After the son of a professional basketball team owner is taken for ransom, Jubal and the team race to catch the kidnappers; they soon discover the perpetrators have been planning a larger revenge plot that they must act quickly to stop.

title: FBI
description:
S08 E14 — Forgiven
After Maggie's sister, Erin, goes missing, the team begins an all-out search to recover her; when Maggie discovers Erin was kidnapped by a sinister figure from her past, she must race to save her before it's too late.

title: FBI
description:
S08 E15 — Crusader
A dangerous drug kingpin from Eva's past resurfaces when two children and a daycare worker are killed due to an accidental drug exposure; Eva wavers between her mission as an agent and her personal vendetta.

title: FBI
description:

A double homicide in Brooklyn sets the team after a corrupt longshoreman, but they soon discover something sinister has been smuggled into New York; Isobel enlists the help of CIA's Deputy Chief of Station Nikki Reynard.

title: FBI
description:
S08 E17 — Shahadah
When the body of a VA psychiatrist is found tortured and deceased under a nearby overpass, the team is led to a suspicious religious leader with a substantial online presence.

title: FBI
description:

When a single mother and her son are abducted while visiting a state park, Maggie brings in Peter Olsen to help profile their suspect; as the team works, they make a harrowing discovery about an old case.

NHL forward Wyatt Johnston and Howie Mandel set up NHL defenseman Lian Bichsel at a restaurant where a romantic proposal meltdown turns him into the unwitting villain.

title: FBI
description:

The team hunts for a serial killer who is targeting young, homeless men; Tiffany and Scola don't see eye to eye on how to handle the case.

title: FBI
description:

After a suburban woman is kidnapped from her home, the team looks into trysts on both sides of a seemingly perfect marriage; OA feels pressure from Mona to make changes in his career path.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E06 — Allegiance
The team must track down a shooter targeting detectives from the same precinct and unit while facing mounting tension from the NYPD; Tiffany finds that her NYPD roots may be influencing her view of the situation.

title: FBI
description:

As the team works to rescue a 5-year-old kidnapping victim, Scola suspects the boy's mother isn't being forthcoming about why her son was targeted; Nina struggles to open up to Scola about matters in their relationship.

title: FBI
description:

Maggie returns from medical leave and helps the team investigate two homicides: a law student and a young man with possible gang ties; an inadvertent revelation from Maggie causes OA to worry that she is rushing back into the job too quickly.

title: FBI
description:
S05 E08 — Into the Fire
When a deadly truck heist arms the killers with enough ammonium nitrate to construct a massive bomb, the team discovers a link to a terrorist group Maggie is working to infiltrate.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E07 — Gone Baby Gone
After a young girl is kidnapped from her daycare, the team must help her parents navigate a debt owed to the deadly gang in their neighborhood; Maggie struggles to focus on the case when her sister returns from rehab.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E08 — Fire and Rain
A widow is shocked that her new "boyfriend" is the manipulative leader of a terrorist group planning an attack; Scola is reminded of his brother's death on 9/11; Tiffany worries about his emotional choices during the investigation.

title: FBI
description:

After Rina is critically wounded while heading to work with Jubal, the team makes the chilling discovery that a vengeful Vargas orchestrated the shooting from behind bars and continues to target the rest of their team and their loved ones.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E10 — Fostered
As the team investigates a string of jewelry store robberies that culminate in a double murder, they uncover a connection to a 16-year-old boy trying to survive the foster care system.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E11 — Grief
The team searches for an abducted college coed; Jubal has a tense encounter with Rina's mother.

title: FBI
description:
S04 E12 — Under Pressure
Maggie goes undercover working in a bar to investigate an anti-government group that regularly gathers there; a single father on the periphery of the group begins to fear he's in danger of becoming collateral damage.

title: John Q
description: A desperate man (Denzel Washington) takes hostages at a hospital in order to force doctors to save his dying son.
